_about: Canonical TokenFarm price record. Edit values here; they are loaded at startup by server/src/game/config.ts. coinCost is spent to buy a seed in the shop; xpReward is earned on harvest (XP is NOT a spendable currency). Crops are listed in ascending cost so the shop renders them in that order. xpLevelBands is the gradually-ascending XP-per-level curve: each band gives the XP needed for every level up through its throughLevel; levels above the last band hold at the last band's rate (no level cap). Add bands to raise it further.
